thread:
zoe-support: flagging Foodly outage -- lots of 5xx/timeouts on hosted inference during their lunchtime promo (~12:00 UTC). They report checkout failures and botched recommendations. Customer wants urgent help.

vik-sre: seeing platform alerts: sudden rise in gateway 5xx and p95 tail latency. request_queue_depth for model ceres-2.7b climbed from ~120 -> 1100 in ~6m. p99 on /v1/generate ~3.8s.

hana-runtime: initial thought: continuous batching windows getting extended by a small portion of long-context analytic requests, causing head-of-line blocking. Also seeing many retries from client libraries that don't honor backoff.

otto-eng: do we have sample payloads? lightweight or long?

zoe-support: Foodly sent sanitized samples: most requests are tiny (few tokens), but they have a periodic analytics job that hits our API with large context occasionally. Example long request: ```json
{"model":"ceres-2.7b","input_len":6400,"max_new_tokens":512}
``` and regular user requests look like `\{"model\":\"ceres-2.7b\",\"prompt\":\"find recipe\"\}`.

vik-sre: logs at 2045679005: 
```
[gateway] WARN request_queue_depth=978 route=/v1/generate tenant=foodly
[batcher] INFO open_batches=44 avg_batch_wait_ms=210 route=ceres-2.7b
[worker] ERROR upstream_status=504 upstream_latency=2005ms request_id=foodly-zz
```

hana-runtime: that avg_batch_wait_ms is the smoking gun. Continuous batching waits to fill batches; a few long requests increase wait time and block many small ones.

otto-eng: quick mitigation options: 1) reduce batcher.max_wait_ms for ceres-2.7b from 200ms -> 25ms 2) enable request-size bucketization so small requests don't join long-request batches 3) apply tenant concurrency cap and low-latency routing for Foodly 4) throttle aggressive retries by returning 429 instead of allowing retries to pile up. Which do we run?

vik-sre: do 1 and 3 immediately. Reduce max_wait_ms and set tenant concurrency cap to 20. Also enable temporary routing override to put Foodly on the low-latency pool.

hana-runtime: applying patch to batcher: ```yaml
model: ceres-2.7b
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  max_wait_ms: 25  # previously 200
```

deploy-bot: config change triggered by hana-runtime at 2045679028  canary 5% -> 100% in 4m.

vik-sre: routing override applied: `routing/tenant/foodly/pool=low-latency` and `routing/tenant/foodly/concurrency=20`.

zoe-support: Foodly reports immediate improvement in error rate after ~90s; 5xx down from ~10% -> 1.2%. They still see occasional 503s from retries.

otto-eng: follow-up: we should surface clearer reason codes for early rejects and throttles. Right now some clients see 5xx and retry hard. Need to ensure early-reject returns 429 with a reason header `X-Redwood-Reason:queue_depth`.

hana-runtime: agreed. Also will push canary for size-based bucketization so small requests take fast-path. I'll open PR for batcher.bucketize_by_input_len with default threshold 256 tokens.

vik-sre: logs after changes at 2045679090: 
```
[gateway] INFO request_queue_depth=180 route=/v1/generate tenant=foodly
[batcher] INFO open_batches=7 avg_batch_wait_ms=22 route=ceres-2.7b
```

zoe-support: customer confirms checkout flow mostly healthy; they noted a few duplicate transactions caused by their client retries. We're offering credits and scheduling a call.

otto-eng: long-term engineering proposals: 1) adaptive batching: reduce max_wait_ms automatically when queue_depth > threshold 2) default size-aware bucketization for shared models 3) tenant burst windows with automatic soft-limits and clear 429 early-rejects 4) client guidance for retry/backoff tuning in docs.

hana-runtime: immediate action items I'm taking: open PR for bucketization, implement adaptive max_wait canary, and add metric `batch_head_blocking_events`.

vik-sre: ops action items: 1) change early-reject behavior to emit 429 for tenant-level rejects (PR queued) 2) add alert "batch_head_blocking" when avg_batch_wait_ms > 150ms AND request_queue_depth > 500 for any model 3) review retry/backoff guidance surfaced to support.

zoe-support: I'll prepare customer communication and set up a 1:1 with Foodly tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Also logging credits. Thanks everyone :heart: 

deploy-bot: incident severity set to P2 by vik-sre. Postmortem stub created at /incidents/postmortems/2045678901-foodly-batcher-headblock (placeholder).
